title: Juniper and the Passage
author: Noor Iversen
blurb: Ivo Pemberton, a salvage diver working a wreck the navy won't discuss, has spent three years measuring life in miles rather than years. Then a dying prospector trades a map for a promise — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must cross the range ahead of the snows, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
